summary: Backend API regression passed on public endpoint; frontend public preview remained unavailable and blocked UI flow validation.

ui_bugs.issue: https://jobtrackr-ai.preview.emergentagent.com shows 'The preview environment is not responding. It may be starting up.' and never loads auth UI.

integration_issues.flow: All frontend flows (auth, board, detection, analytics, profile)
integration_issues.issue: Blocked because public web preview is unavailable; auth-mode-toggle testID never appears.

action_items: Fix/recover public Expo preview tunnel availability first (ngrok tunnel failures observed in supervisor expo logs).
After preview recovery, rerun full mobile UI tests for auth, add app, kanban move, detection popup actions, analytics tab, profile Gmail gating, and screenshot picker.
Security hardening: remove JWT_SECRET fallback ('change-me') and fail fast when missing secret in production-like environments.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses JWT_SECRET default fallback value ('change-me') instead of strict env-only configuration.

Several interactive frontend elements rely on web-only data-testid injection without explicit testID prop (e.g., gmail-sync-button, source chips, detection text input), reducing native testability consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ unique user via /api/auth/register and transient test applications/detection; cleanup test deleted created applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL first per policy. If still down, capture outage evidence quickly, then coordinate infrastructure recovery before rerunning UI integration suite.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open public URL -> page shows preview not responding; Playwright times out waiting for [data-testid='auth-mode-toggle']. Logs: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log shows repeated ngrok tunnel connection failures and tunnel startup errors. Mitigation: stabilize Expo tunnel/public preview service, then rerun UI E2E.
